unit_cn: Unit 4 Life and Technology 生活与科技
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 4 词表(p82-84 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、科技/机器人/5G/人工智能主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;△超纲与专名跳过。

words.meaning_cn: 柔韧的;灵活的;可变动的
words.example_en: The robot dog had very flexible movements and could dance.
words.example_cn: 这只机器狗动作非常灵活,还能跳舞。

words.example_en: The smart robot quickly attracted the children's attention.
words.example_cn: 这个智能机器人很快吸引了孩子们的注意。

words.example_en: At first sight, the robot dog looked just like a real one.
words.example_cn: 乍一看,这只机器狗就像真狗一样。

words.example_en: Modern robots possess the ability to learn new tasks.
words.example_cn: 现代机器人具有学习新任务的能力。

words.meaning_cn: 令人赞叹的;令人敬佩的
words.example_en: The robot's interactive design was really impressive.
words.example_cn: 这款机器人的交互设计真的令人赞叹。

words.example_en: The robot dog could respond to its owner's commands.
words.example_cn: 这只机器狗能对主人的命令作出反应。

words.meaning_cn: 观看;仔细察看;把……视为;看法
words.example_en: A built-in camera let people view the world through the dog's eyes.
words.example_cn: 内置摄像头让人们透过机器狗的眼睛观看世界。

words.meaning_cn: 要求高的;苛求的;难满足的
words.example_en: Training a robot to behave well is a demanding task.
words.example_cn: 训练机器人表现得当是一项要求很高的任务。

words.meaning_cn: 成熟的;发育完全的;明事理的
words.example_en: The robot dog could be programmed to act like a mature adult dog.
words.example_cn: 这只机器狗可以被设定得像一只成熟的成年犬。

words.example_en: The owner set the robot to behave like an adult dog rather than a puppy.
words.example_cn: 主人把机器狗设定成像成年犬而非幼犬那样行事。

words.example_en: Some users complain that smart machines are hard to control.
words.example_cn: 一些用户抱怨智能机器很难控制。

words.example_en: Without hesitation, the boy started playing with the robot dog.
words.example_cn: 男孩毫不犹豫地开始和机器狗玩耍。

words.meaning_cn: 热情的;热心的;满腔热忱的
words.example_en: The robot dog gave an enthusiastic response whenever I petted it.
words.example_cn: 每当我抚摸它,机器狗都会作出热情的回应。

words.example_en: The little machine evoked a strong emotional response in me.
words.example_cn: 这个小机器在我心中唤起了强烈的情感反应。

words.meaning_cn: 情感的;情绪的;感情冲动的
words.example_en: A robot pet cannot build a true emotional connection with you.
words.example_cn: 机器宠物无法与你建立真正的情感联系。

words.meaning_cn: (作用)强烈的;有权势的;强大的
words.example_en: A real emotional connection is powerful and important.
words.example_cn: 真正的情感联系是强烈而重要的。

words.example_en: After a while, my enthusiasm for the robot dog began to die down.
words.example_cn: 过了一阵子,我对机器狗的热情开始减退。

words.example_en: I was constantly losing my patience with the robot dog.
words.example_cn: 我对这只机器狗一直在失去耐心。

words.example_en: Training a robot pet requires a lot of patience.
words.example_cn: 训练机器宠物需要很大的耐心。

words.example_en: It began to annoy me that the robot would not obey.
words.example_cn: 机器狗不听话开始让我恼火。

words.example_en: Unlike a real pup, the robot dog did not breathe or eat.
words.example_cn: 和真小狗不同,机器狗不呼吸也不吃东西。

words.example_en: Eventually, I stopped calling the machine "he".
words.example_cn: 最后,我不再把这台机器叫作“他”。

words.meaning_cn: 交互式的;人机对话的;互动的
words.example_en: As an interactive toy, the robot dog was fun to watch.
words.example_cn: 作为一个互动玩具,这只机器狗看着很有趣。

words.example_en: With 5G, a doctor can perform remote surgery from far away.
words.example_cn: 有了5G,医生可以从远方进行远程手术。

words.example_en: The surgeon directed the operation from hundreds of kilometres away.
words.example_cn: 这位外科医生从数百公里外指挥了手术。

words.example_en: He used a surgical robot to operate on the patient.
words.example_cn: 他用一台手术机器人为病人做了手术。

words.example_en: The whole operation was carried out over a 5G connection.
words.example_cn: 整台手术是通过5G连接完成的。

words.example_en: What makes remote surgery attractive is that experts need not travel.
words.example_cn: 远程手术之所以诱人,是因为专家无需长途奔波。

words.example_en: Leading specialists can now help with operations from far away.
words.example_cn: 顶尖专家如今可以从远方协助手术。

words.example_en: The doctor operated on the patient remotely with a robot.
words.example_cn: 医生用机器人远程为病人动了手术。

words.example_en: Until now, doctors lacked a fast and stable Internet connection.
words.example_cn: 直到现在,医生还缺乏快速而稳定的网络连接。

words.example_en: A 3D model of the heart was built using artificial intelligence.
words.example_cn: 心脏的三维模型是用人工智能建立的。

words.example_en: Artificial intelligence can process medical images very quickly.
words.example_cn: 人工智能能非常快速地处理医学影像。

words.example_en: The team studied medical images on a computer screen.
words.example_cn: 团队在电脑屏幕上研究医学影像。

words.example_en: They used a live video conference link to guide the operating team.
words.example_cn: 他们用实时视频会议连接来指导手术团队。

words.example_en: The surgeon told the team where to cut and where to sew up.
words.example_cn: 外科医生告诉团队在哪里切开、在哪里缝合。

words.example_en: A small camera was placed inside the patient's chest.
words.example_cn: 一台小摄像头被放置在病人的胸腔内。

words.example_en: Advanced Internet technology saves doctors a lot of travel time.
words.example_cn: 先进的网络技术为医生节省了大量出行时间。

words.example_en: This new technique has now been repeated all over China.
words.example_cn: 这项新技术如今已在全国各地多次使用。

words.example_en: Doctors far apart now have the chance to work together.
words.example_cn: 相隔很远的医生如今有机会一起合作。

words.example_en: The 5G network is many times faster than the 4G one.
words.example_cn: 5G网络比4G网络快很多倍。

words.example_en: 5G is faster than the 4G Internet we currently use.
words.example_cn: 5G比我们目前使用的4G网络更快。

words.example_en: 5G provides a more stable connection by reducing signal delay.
words.example_cn: 5G通过减少信号延迟提供更稳定的连接。

words.example_en: With 5G, the delay drops to about one millisecond.
words.example_cn: 使用5G,延迟降到大约一毫秒。

words.meaning_cn: 把……安置在;位于;找出……的位置
words.example_en: The surgeon was located in one city while the patient was in another.
words.example_cn: 外科医生在一座城市,而病人在另一座城市。

words.meaning_cn: 联系;使有联系;把……联系起来
words.example_en: This report relates technology to our everyday life.
words.example_cn: 这篇报告把科技与我们的日常生活联系起来。

words.example_en: Robots are now used to help soldiers carry heavy loads.
words.example_cn: 机器人如今被用来帮助士兵搬运重物。

words.example_en: A team of experts studied a 3D model before the operation.
words.example_cn: 手术前一组专家研究了一个三维模型。

words.meaning_cn: 有效的;产生预期结果的
words.example_en: 5G has become an effective tool for long-distance surgery.
words.example_cn: 5G已成为远程手术的一种有效工具。

words.example_en: The expert used a video link to instruct the operating team.
words.example_cn: 专家通过视频连接指示手术团队。
